item.title: Arie Luyendyk Jr. plans second vasectomy after Baby No. 4 with Lauren Burnham
item.description: The Bachelor: Arie Luyendyk Jr. plans second vasectomy after Baby No. 4 with Lauren Burnham. The Bachelor alum Arie Luyendyk Jr. has announced his plans to undergo a second vasectomy two months after welcoming his fourth child with wife Lauren Burnham.

item.title: 'The Amazing Race' Couples Now: Where are they now? Who is still together? (PHOTOS)
item.description: The Amazing Race: 'The Amazing Race' Couples Now: Where are they now? Who is still together? (PHOTOS) . The Amazing Race has been airing on CBS for 24 years, which means viewers have seen dozens of engaged or dating couples race around the world during that time.

item.title: Dylan Efron reveals Zac Efron got "defensive" over his viral reaction to 'Dancing with the Stars' scores
item.description: Dancing with the Stars: Dylan Efron reveals Zac Efron got "defensive" over his viral reaction to 'Dancing with the Stars' scores. Dancing with the Stars finalist Dylan Efron has revealed that his older brother, actor Zac Efron, got "defensive" when he heard his reaction to Dylan's scores from the DWTS judges went viral.

item.title: 'The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City' alum Jen Shah released from prison
item.description: The Real Housewives: 'The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City' alum Jen Shah released from prison. The Real Housewives of Salt Lake City alum Jen Shah has been released from prison after serving nearly three years behind bars for a fraudulent telemarketing scheme.

item.title: 'The Golden Bachelor's Peg Munson shares Mel Owens relationship update and marriage plans
item.description: The Bachelor: 'The Golden Bachelor's Peg Munson shares Mel Owens relationship update and marriage plans. The Golden Bachelor's Season 2 winner Peg Munson has shared a relationship update with Mel Owens and whether they've talked about marriage.

item.title: 'The Amazing Race' finale: 'Big Brother' winner Jag Bains and brother Jas Bains win Season 38
item.description: The Amazing Race: 'The Amazing Race' finale: 'Big Brother' winner Jag Bains and brother Jas Bains win Season 38. The Amazing Race featured "Brothers and entrepreneurs" Jag Bains and Jas Bains crossing the finish line in New York in first place and winning $1 million during the Season 38 finale that aired Wednesday night on CBS.

item.title: 'Survivor': Steven Ramm blindsided and voted out despite using "Block a Vote" advantage
item.description: Survivor: 'Survivor': Steven Ramm blindsided and voted out despite using "Block a Vote" advantage. Survivor featured the Lewatu tribe unanimously voting out Steven Ramm although he had played his "Block a Vote" advantage during Season 49's penultimate episode that aired Wednesday night on CBS.

item.description: The Bachelor: Peg Munson: It "was really hard" watching 'The Golden Bachelor' with Mel Owens. The Golden Bachelor alum Peg Munson has opened up about how watching Season 2 of The Golden Bachelor back on ABC was tough at times.

item.title: Juliana Pasquarosa says Litia Garr betrayed her and spoiled the ending of Grant Ellis' 'The Bachelor' season
item.description: The Bachelor: Juliana Pasquarosa says Litia Garr betrayed her and spoiled the ending of Grant Ellis' 'The Bachelor' season. The Bachelor alum Juliana Pasquarosa has claimed Grant Ellis' runner-up Litia Garr betrayed her by spoiling the ending of their season.
